<style id="tll-acct-gate-v2">
/* 8 Oct 2026 (Nancy: "that funny Shelf page is coming up again when I login"). The signed-out gate card ("Your shelf is behind
   the sign-in") sits in a data-ms-content="anonymous" block that is visible until Memberstack hides it, so it flashes on every
   login redirect and stays if Memberstack is slow. Hide it by default; the script below shows it only once Memberstack says
   there is no member, or after six seconds with no answer so a signed-out visitor is never left with an empty page. */
html:not(.tll-anon) [data-ms-content="anonymous"]{display:none !important}
</style>
<script id="tll-acct-gate-v2-js">
(function(){
  var done=false; function anon(){ if(done) return; done=true; document.documentElement.classList.add('tll-anon'); }
  function check(){ var ms=window.$memberstackDom; if(!ms||!ms.getCurrentMember) return false;
    ms.getCurrentMember().then(function(r){ if(!r||!r.data) anon(); else done=true; }).catch(function(){ anon(); }); return true; }
  var n=0, iv=setInterval(function(){ if(check()||++n>20){ clearInterval(iv); if(n>20) anon(); } },300);
  setTimeout(anon,6000);
})();
</script>
<style id="tll-acct-signout-v1">
/* 9 Oct 2026 (Nancy: "It is not intuitive how to log out of the site"). A plain sign-out link under the greeting; the Sign out card at the foot of the page stays. */
[data-tll-acct-signout]{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#F7F1E8;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(247,241,232,.45);padding-bottom:3px;transition:border-color .15s ease}
[data-tll-acct-signout]:hover{border-bottom-color:#F7F1E8}
[data-tll-acct-signout]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #D63859;outline-offset:3px}
html.tll-anon [data-tll-acct-signout]{display:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){[data-tll-acct-signout]{transition:none}}
</style>
<style id="tll-a3-account-v1">
/* tll-a3-account-v1 · Account 3.0 (approved by Nancy 12 Oct 2026, "Go with defaults"). Restyle only: CSS on wrappers, classes and data-tll-* hooks.
   Never targets [data-ms-*] for anything but the existing sign-out hook. Tabs, status line, progress and gate lines are built by tll-a3-account-js-v1.
   With JS off nothing here hides content: the rail only shows under html.a3-on. Motion: hover and press only, named properties, off with reduced motion. */
.tll-account-hero{padding:40px 0 36px!important;background:#0A0B14}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-hero-inner{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(16px,4vw,48px);box-sizing:border-box}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-hero-row{margin-bottom:0!important;gap:28px;align-items:center}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-avatar-wrap{width:96px!important;height:96px!important;border:2.5px solid #F0507A;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:none!important;background:#26324D!important}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-eyebrow{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace!important;font-size:11px!important;letter-spacing:3px!important;font-weight:600!important;color:#00C9C8!important;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px!important}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-headline{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif!important;font-weight:800!important;font-size:clamp(38px,4.6vw,60px)!important;line-height:1!important;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#F7F1E8;margin:0!important}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-em{color:#F0507A;font-style:italic}
.tll-account-hero .tll-account-sub{color:#cfcbc4;font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;max-width:62ch;margin:14px 0 0;opacity:1}
.a3-status{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}
.a3-status li{border:1px solid #3a3d52;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 9px;color:#cfcbc4}
.a3-btn-edit,.tll-account-hero [data-tll-acct-signout]{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 18px;margin:18px 0 0;border-radius:4px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2px;text-transform:none;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease-out,background-color .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out}
.a3-btn-edit{margin-right:10px;color:#F7F1E8;border:1.5px solid #F7F1E8;background:transparent}
.tll-account-hero [data-tll-acct-signout]{color:#F7F1E8;border:1.5px solid #3a3d55;background:transparent}
html.tll-anon .tll-account-hero [data-tll-acct-signout]{display:none}
.tll-account-hero :focus-visible,.tll-account-hero [data-tll-acct-signout]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #00C9C8!important;outline-offset:3px}
.a3-prog{margin-top:24px;max-width:560px}
.a3-prog-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#b8b4ad;margin-bottom:6px}
.a3-prog-top a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;color:#00C9C8;text-decoration:none;font:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit}
.a3-bar{height:6px;background:#23263c;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.a3-bar>span{display:block;height:100%;background:#00C9C8}

/* Rail and panels (A12, A14). Only under html.a3-on, never for a signed-out visitor. */
.a3-rail,.a3-ph{display:none}
html.a3-on .a3-rail{display:block}
html.a3-on .a3-ph{display:flex}
html.tll-anon .a3-rail,html.tll-anon .a3-ph{display:none!important}
[data-a3-off]{display:none!important}
html.a3-on [data-ms-content=members]{background:#FDF9F3}
.a3-rail{box-sizing:border-box;padding:28px 0 16px}
.a3-rail [role=tablist]{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.a3-tab,.a3-rail-link{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:44px;margin:0;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:#0A0B14;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Condensed','IBM Plex Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;text-align:left;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out}
.a3-tab[aria-selected=true]{background:#0A0B14;color:#F7F1E8;font-weight:700}
.a3-badge{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:#6B6660}
.a3-tab[aria-selected=true] .a3-badge{color:#00C9C8}
.a3-rail-link{margin-top:8px;border-top:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:0 0 4px 4px;color:#067A79}
.a3-tab:focus-visible,.a3-rail-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0A0B14;outline-offset:2px}
.a3-ph{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:12px 16px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:28px 0 12px;outline:none}
.a3-ph h2{margin:0 0 6px;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:34px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.015em;color:#0A0B14}
.a3-ph p{margin:0;font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;color:#3a3a3a;max-width:62ch}
.a3-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 18px;border-radius:4px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;color:#06302f;background:#00C9C8;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out}
.a3-cta-rose{color:#fff;background:#D63859}
.a3-ph:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0A0B14;outline-offset:4px}
@media (min-width:831px){
  html.a3-on [data-ms-content=members].a3-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(clamp(16px,4vw,48px),1fr) 252px minmax(0,956px) minmax(clamp(16px,4vw,48px),1fr);align-items:start}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid>*{grid-column:3;min-width:0}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid>:first-child,html.a3-on .a3-grid>.tll-account-hero{grid-column:1/-1}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid>.a3-rail{grid-column:2;grid-row:3/span 40;position:sticky;top:16px;padding-right:32px}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-actions-section,html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-mine-section,html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-settings-section{padding:8px 0 40px!important;background:transparent}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-actions-section>.tll-container,html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-mine-section>.tll-container,html.a3-on .a3-grid .tll-account-settings-section>.tll-container{max-width:none;width:auto;padding-left:0;padding-right:0;margin:0}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid [data-tll-ls=sec],html.a3-on .a3-grid [data-tll-wr=sec]{padding:8px 0 28px}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid [data-tll-acct=extras]{background:transparent}
  html.a3-on .a3-grid [data-tll-acct=map] #my-map{border-radius:4px}
}
@media (max-width:830px){
  html.a3-on .a3-rail{position:static;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;border-bottom:1px solid #E0DACE;background:#FDF9F3;max-width:100vw}
  html.a3-on .a3-rail [role=tablist]{flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:nowrap}
  .a3-tab,.a3-rail-link{width:auto;flex:none;white-space:nowrap}
  .a3-rail-link{margin:0;border-top:0}
  .a3-ph{padding:24px 16px 8px}
  .a3-ph h2{font-size:28px}
}
/* Old dotted eyebrows and the duplicate "Account." heading give way to the panel headings while tabs are on. */
html.a3-on .tll-account-mine-block>.tll-eyebrow-rose,html.a3-on .tll-account-mine-block>.tll-eyebrow-teal,html.a3-on .tll-account-settings-section .tll-container>.tll-eyebrow-rose,html.a3-on .tll-account-settings-title{display:none}
html.a3-on .tll-account-mine-title{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;font-style:normal;margin:0 0 4px}

/* Overview cards (A4): Ink tiles, 4px radius, mono label, Playfair number, one action. */
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-pickin-card{border:1px solid #23263c!important;border-radius:4px!important;min-height:200px;outline:0!important;transition:border-color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out!important}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-pickin-card:hover{outline:0!important}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-mod-label{display:block;margin:16px 16px 0;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#00C9C8}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-pickin-card-marigold .tll-mod-label{color:#FF7093}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-pickin-card-midnight .tll-mod-label{color:#D98A2B}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-mod-count{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:34px;line-height:1;margin:6px 16px 0;color:#F7F1E8}
.tll-account-actions-section [data-tll-mod=countries]~.tll-mod-count::after{content:" of 249";font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:13px;font-weight:400;color:#b8b4ad;letter-spacing:0}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-mod-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;margin:auto 0 0!important;padding:0 16px!important;border:0!important;border-top:1px solid #23263c!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;color:#00C9C8!important;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-pickin-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0A0B14!important;outline-offset:3px}
.tll-account-actions-section .tll-acct-data{border-radius:4px}
.tll-acct-data .tll-acct-data-b{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:4px;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out}
.tll-acct-data .tll-acct-data-del{color:#B02A4C;border-color:#B02A4C}
.tll-acct-data .tll-acct-data-t{font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;color:#0A0B14}
.a3-note{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:14px;color:#6B6660}
.a3-note a{color:#067A79;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.tll-acct-data a:focus-visible,.a3-note a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0A0B14;outline-offset:2px}

/* Wrapped and Finish your profile (A5). */
[data-tll-wr=card]{border-radius:4px}
[data-tll-wr=hide]{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:0 16px;border-radius:4px;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out,transform .15s ease-out}
[data-tll-wr=hide][aria-pressed=true]{color:#0A0B14}
[data-tll-wr=hide]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #00C9C8;outline-offset:3px}
[data-tll-wr=inner].a3-wr2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:start}
.a3-finish{background:#fff;border:1px solid #E0DACE;border-radius:4px;padding:20px 22px}
.a3-finish h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-family:'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif;font-weight:800;font-size:22px;color:#0A0B14}
.a3-finish>p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:14px;color:#6B6660}
.a3-finish ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.a3-finish li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;border-top:1px solid #F0EBE0;font-size:15px;color:#0A0B14}
.a3-dot{flex:none;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;box-sizing:border-box;border:1.5px solid #6B6660;color:#0A0B14}
.a3-done .a3-dot{background:#067A79;border-color:#067A79;color:#fff}
.a3-done .a3-lbl{color:#6B6660}
.a3-lbl{flex:1}
.a3-add{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;font-weight:700;color:#C8325B;text-decoration:none}
.a3-add:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0A0B14;outline-offset:2px}
.a3-sr{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:767px){[data-tll-wr=inner].a3-wr2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* Your lists and Log a place (A7): chips, 4px stickers, Log a place above the sheet, one rule line per tab. */
[data-tll-ls=inner]{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
[data-tll-ls=inner]>[data-tll-ls=head]{order:1}
[data-tll-ls=inner]>[data-tll-ls=tabs]{order:2}
[data-tll-ls=inner]>.a3-rule{order:3}
[data-tll-ls=inner]>[data-tll-log]{order:4}
[data-tll-ls=inner]>[data-tll-ls=sheet]{order:5}

    var h1=$('h1',hero); after(h1,st);
    var c=checks(m), done=c.filter(function(x){return x[1];}).length, next=c.filter(function(x){return !x[1];})[0];
    var pr=el('div',{'class':'a3-prog'});
    var tp=el('div',{'class':'a3-prog-top'}); var lab=el('span',{id:'a3-prog-l'},'PROFILE '+done+' OF '+c.length+' DONE'); tp.appendChild(lab);
    tp.appendChild(el('a',{href:'/edit-profile'},next?('Add: '+next[0].toLowerCase()+' →'):'All done →'));
    pr.appendChild(tp);
    var bar=el('div',{'class':'a3-bar',role:'progressbar','aria-labelledby':'a3-prog-l','aria-valuemin':'0','aria-valuemax':String(c.length),'aria-valuenow':String(done)});
    var fill=el('span'); fill.style.width=Math.round(done/c.length*100)+'%'; bar.appendChild(fill); pr.appendChild(bar);
    var row=$('.tll-account-hero-row',hero); after(row||h1,pr);
    var wrIn=wr&&$('[data-tll-wr="inner"]',wr);
    if(wrIn&&!$('.a3-finish',wrIn)){
      var f=el('section',{'class':'a3-finish','aria-labelledby':'a3-fin-h'});
      f.appendChild(el('h3',{id:'a3-fin-h'},'Finish your profile'));
      f.appendChild(el('p',null,'It shows on your Travelers card.'));
      var ul=el('ul');
      c.forEach(function(x){
        var li=el('li',x[1]?{'class':'a3-done'}:null);
        li.appendChild(el('span',{'class':'a3-dot','aria-hidden':'true'},x[1]?'✓':''));
        var l=el('span',{'class':'a3-lbl'},x[0]); l.appendChild(el('span',{'class':'a3-sr'},x[1]?' (done)':' (to do)')); li.appendChild(l);
        if(!x[1]){ li.appendChild(el('a',{href:'/edit-profile','class':'a3-add','aria-label':'Add '+x[0].toLowerCase()},'ADD →')); }
        ul.appendChild(li);
      });
      f.appendChild(ul); wrIn.appendChild(f); wrIn.classList.add('a3-wr2');
    }
  }
  var tries=0, iv=setInterval(function(){
    var ms=window.$memberstackDom;
    if(ms&&ms.getCurrentMember){ clearInterval(iv); ms.getCurrentMember().then(function(r){ paintMember(r&&r.data); }).catch(function(){}); }
    else if(++tries>30) clearInterval(iv);
  },300);
})();
